What is stored: fields, types, permitted values and ranges.
Reconstructing the exact point in time
Times are stored as the clock time in {timezone}. Together with this time zone they give the exact point in time, for example in UTC.
When clocks go back in autumn, one hour of clock time occurs twice; values from that hour are ambiguous without further information.
